provenance.instrument: Code of the Township of Upper Dublin, Chapter 255 Zoning, as published by American Legal Publishing
provenance.status_detail: Unit rule 255-27E(1) as amended 4-13-2010 (Ord. No. 10-1229) and 8-12-2014 (Ord. No. 14-1291). Code page: 'Code supplemented and revised through October 13, 2026' (2026 S-11). American Legal shows no list of adopted laws not yet codified.
provenance.code_current_through_note: American Legal title page: 'Code supplemented and revised through October 13, 2026'.
checks: A second dwelling unit in a single-family detached house or in a building accessory to it is a special exception (Zoning Hearing Board), for 'household employees, caretakers, caregivers, or members of the owner's immediate family' only (255-27E(1))
Immediate family means grandparent, parent, child or grandchild of a person or spouse (255-7)
The owner records a covenant running with the land that limits the unit to those occupants (255-27E(1)(b))
The lot may not also have rented rooms, home day care, a professional office or a minor home occupation (255-27E(1)(a))

Size: the accessory building's floor area is at most 40% of the house's floor area or 1,200 sq ft, whichever is less. The text names the accessory building, so a unit inside the house has no stated cap. Ask the zoning officer (255-27E(1)(d))

Height: a detached building with the unit 13 ft for one story, 22 ft for two stories, to the peak. The district tables cap accessory buildings at 20 ft, and 255-29A caps them at 22 ft or the house height, whichever is less. An attached unit no taller than the house (255-27E(1)(e), 255-43B, 255-44A, 255-45B, 255-29A)
A detached building with the unit must meet the house's setbacks. Accessory buildings stand in a side or rear yard, not the front yard, 10 ft from the house (255-27E(1)(f), 255-29)
General accessory building cap: 600 sq ft of building coverage (except a barn). Whether it binds a unit building is not settled (255-29B)
Parking: two all-weather spaces per family plus garage space, met for both units, so four (255-135A, 255-27E(1)(c))

Historic Resource Overlay: on a property with a Class 1 or Class 2 historic resource an 'Accessory apartment' is a conditional use (Board of Commissioners) after a Historical Commission recommendation, in the resource or in an accessory structure that existed when Article XXXIV was adopted (255-255B(1)(d))

A district lots depend on utilities (255-15A, amended 7-9-2024 by Ord. No. 24-1391): both public sewer and water 26,000 sq ft (stored), one of them 35,000 sq ft, neither 45,000 sq ft with one-story accessory buildings
A-1 and A-2: accessory buildings 20 ft and one story, so a two-story unit building is barred there (255-43.1)
Height of a two-story unit building: 22 ft under 255-27E(1)(e) or 20 ft under the district tables. Stored as 20 ft. Ask the zoning officer
No nonconforming-lot section was found in Article XX (255-142 to 255-151 are nonconforming use sections)
provenance.notes: Zoning office: Upper Dublin Township (upperdublin.net). Read on American Legal in a browser, one section page at a time. Searched for accessory dwelling, accessory apartment, in-law, caretaker, household employee, immediate family, conversion, short-term. The unit has no defined name. 255-27E(1)(e) and (f) call it an 'accessory dwelling unit'. 255-27D allows renting rooms in the owner's dwelling to at most two nontransient persons (not a separate unit). Nonconforming lot rules (255-24.1 merger of lots, Article XX) not read.

term.note: No defined term. 255-27E(1): 'Dwelling unit either within a single family detached dwelling or a building accessory thereto for household employees, caretakers, caregivers, or members of the owner's immediate family'. (e) and (f) call it an 'accessory dwelling unit'.

status.note: Special exception. Occupants: household employees, caretakers, caregivers, or members of the owner's immediate family, with a recorded covenant. Not relatives only: a caretaker or household employee also qualifies. The path is in approval.path.

path.note: 'The following when authorized as a special exception' (255-27E). Zoning Hearing Board under Article XXIII.

fallback_path.note: A unit for other occupants, or one that fails 255-27E(1), needs a variance from the Zoning Hearing Board. No unlisted-use section found.

value.name: Accessory apartment for a historic resource
value.conditions: Property in the Historic Resource Overlay with a Class 1 or Class 2 historic resource. Historical Commission recommendation and conditional use approval by the Board of Commissioners. May be in an accessory structure that existed when Article XXXIV was adopted. A financial guarantee under 255-257B(4) first.
value.note: No occupant rule in (d). The resource's eligibility is set by the Historic Resource Inventory (A264-1).

value.name: Conversion of a single-family dwelling
value.conditions: Petition signed by owners of 60% or more of the frontage on the same street within 1,000 ft. Each unit at least 500 sq ft. Lot area per family at least 75% of the district requirement. District yards kept. No external alteration except for safety. The Zoning Hearing Board sets the number of families (255-19F). 'The conversion shall be authorized only for a large dwelling with relatively little economic usefulness as a conforming use' (255-19H).
value.note: Two units need 1.5 times the district lot: A 39,000, B 18,000, C 13,500, NH 8,250 sq ft.

value.name: Duplex or twin dwelling
value.conditions: At least 6,000 sq ft of lot for each unit.

value.name: Twin dwelling
value.conditions: Each unit of a twin or duplex 3,300 sq ft of lot and its own yards.
value.note: A new twin building. Converting a house would need 255-19.

zoning_districts.note: 255-27 lists uses 'accessory to dwellings' and E(1) needs a single-family detached dwelling. Single-family detached dwellings are permitted in A, B, C and NH (255-39), and A-1 and A-2 follow the A rules. Other districts were not read for single-family dwellings.

building_types.note: 'within a single family detached dwelling or a building accessory thereto'.

existing_structure_only.note: (e) and (f) set rules for a detached accessory building containing the unit and for a unit attached to the house.

historic_bypass.note: The historic accessory apartment is a separate listing (conditional use). See alternatives.

value.condition: Who may live there: household employees, caretakers, caregivers, or members of the owner's immediate family (grandparent, parent, child or grandchild of a person or spouse). A caretaker or household employee need not be a relative.
Owner records a covenant running with the land limiting the unit to these occupants.
No rented rooms, home day care, professional office or minor home occupation on the property.
Detached building with the unit: house setbacks. 13 ft to the peak for one story, 22 ft for two stories, within the district's 20 ft accessory height. Attached: no taller than the house.
Accessory buildings may not exceed one story in A-1, A-2, and A lots served by neither public sewer nor public water. A two-story unit building is barred there.
Off-street parking met for both units: two all-weather spaces per family besides garage space.

types_allowed.note: Within the house or 'a building accessory thereto'. (e) names a unit attached to the house. A garage is an accessory building.

max_sqft_accessory_building.note: 'The floor area of the accessory building can be no more than 40% of the floor area of the principal dwelling, or 1,200 square feet, whichever is less.'

max_sqft_internal.note: The cap names the accessory building. No cap stated for a unit inside or attached to the house.

max_height_ft.note: Open point. 255-27E(1)(e) (2014): 13 ft for a one-story building, 22 ft for a two-story building, to the peak. The district tables (2008) cap 'Accessory building' at 20 ft. 255-29A defers to a specific rule. 22 ft is the likely reading for two stories, 13 ft binds one story. 20 ft is stored as the safe figure.

height_capped_at_house.note: Accessory buildings no taller than 'the lesser of 22 feet or the height of the principal building'. An attached unit no taller than the existing house.

internal_uses_district_height.note: An attached unit 'shall not exceed the existing height of the principal dwelling'. The district principal height is 35 ft.

district_yards_bind_accessory.note: 'A detached accessory building containing an accessory dwelling unit must meet the building setback requirements for the principal dwelling on the lot.'

front_yard_barred.note: 'Accessory buildings, structures, and uses may be erected or conducted in a side or rear yard, but not a front yard'.

separation_ft.note: 'no closer than 10 feet from the principal building'.

accessory_structure_max_sqft.note: 'An accessory building or structure, other than a barn may not exceed 600 square feet in building coverage.'

accessory_cap_binds_adu.note: Not settled. 255-27E(1)(d) allows up to 1,200 sq ft of floor area in the accessory building. 255-29B caps building coverage at 600 sq ft. A two-story unit building could meet both.

owner_occupancy.note: No express owner occupancy rule. The occupants are tied to the owner (immediate family) or the household (employees, caregivers).

family_only.note: Household employees, caretakers, caregivers or the owner's immediate family.

occupancy.value: Household employees, caretakers, caregivers, or members of the owner's immediate family (grandparent, parent, child or grandchild of a person or spouse).

max_adus.note: 'Dwelling unit' in the singular. No number stated.

short_term_rental_banned.note: The occupants are limited by covenant, so a short-term rental is not possible. No short-term rental rule in Chapter 255.

spaces_required.note: 'Dwelling. Two all-weather parking spaces per family on the same lot therewith. Such parking spaces shall be in addition to enclosed garage space.' Read as two more for the unit.

total_on_site.note: 'The off-street parking requirements of this chapter are met for both dwelling units.'

min_lot_sqft.note: With both public sewer and public water (255-15A(3), amended 7-9-2024 by Ord. No. 24-1391). Neither: 45,000 sq ft, 150 ft wide, yards 60 / 30 / 60, accessory building one story (255-15A(1)). One of the two: 35,000 sq ft, 130 ft, 60 / 25 / 60 (255-15A(2)).
With sanitary sewers and public water. 26,000 sq ft where sewers are installed and capped (255-43.1A(1)). Accessory building 20 ft and one story.
Residential development plan required (Article VI). At least 40% of the lots 18,000 sq ft or larger. Public water and sewer required. Accessory building 20 ft and one story.

setback_side_ft.note: 40 ft together, 15 ft each side (10 ft in some cases).
